content.title: Nuclear Stock Touted As 'Levered Play' On Power Demand
content.summary: Nuclear power startup Oklo is bouncing on Monday, after sliding 18% last week, as Barclays initiated coverage with an overweight rating.  The analysts explained why they see Oklo as a "levered play" with "material upside from current levels."  Oklo closed at an all-time high of 142.65 on Sept. 23, a day after it said it was breaking ground on its first Aurora Powerhouse reactor, in Idaho.
